1. 前往仓库履行补仓承诺 [move] {action=move bridgeStep=to-warehouse commitmentId=cm-cfddcd98-73b9-4f09-9400-5cbbf63ccf1e commitmentRevision=1 legacyTaskId=task-004-supply-warehouse purpose=travel to=warehouse} 前提:alive、accepted commitment revision unchanged

3. 就地休息 [rest] {action=rest minutes=60} 前提:awake

5. 去伐木场收集木柴 [gather] {action=gather amount=2 resource=firewood} 前提:stamina > 15
